content:
maya: quick heads-up — found a confusing state in Capacity Editor. edit Min/Max on Pool A, then switch to Pool B: fields show edited numbers but appear disabled. users think values apply to Pool B.
alex: can you repro steps and mock?
maya: repro: Min 2->4, Max 6->8, switch pools. UI greys inputs and shows 4/8 with dashed outline, no hint it's a draft for Pool A.
liam: proposal: show a keyboard-focusable pill above inputs: "Draft changes saved for Pool A". pill gives actions: Apply to Pool B / Discard. show validation state (ok/warn).
rachel: copy: use full text for desktop, condensed "Draft · Pool A" for narrow. Apply primary, Discard link. include estimated cost in Apply CTA.
zoe: accessibility: announce pill via aria-live polite, move focus to pill on pool switch, support Enter to open actions and Escape to discard. ensure live region + role=status.
alex: draft persistence?
maya: session-scoped localStorage with 24h TTL. show toast after nav: "You have unsaved capacity changes for Pool A — Continue editing · Discard".
liam: validations: if drafted Min > target pool max, show inline error on pill: "Min (4) exceeds Pool B maximum (2). Reduce Min or pick a different pool." block Apply until fixed.
rachel: SLO: treat as route-level and persist across pool switches; if pool can't meet SLO show disabled slider + "Find compatible pools".
zoe: burst label change: "Allow temporary burst (up to X GPUs)" and info icon with aria-label. show dashed "Burst unavailable for Pool B" if not supported.
deploy-bot: preview: capacity-drafts/ghost-draft-pill v3 — https://staging.redwood/preview/1746023333 (expires in 3h) :rocket:
alex: thanks — maya please mock pill+toast+copy for 15-min review tomorrow 11:00.
maya: on it, will include keyboard test script and accessibility checklist in PR.
